message: いい歌だった
I head toward the church.
Since I'm attending Ryuusei Academy and borrowing the power of a guardian angel as part of the Crusaders, I ought to worship every now and then.
In the center of the empty chapel stood Azel, wearing a serene expression she had never shown everyone.
T-This is bad. I don't want to disturb Azel while she looks so calm and composed.
Doing this here must be her best way to relax. How can I slip out quietly without staring curiously or letting her notice me?

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't make such an openly disgusted face.」

name: Azel
message: 「......What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I just came to worship.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for getting in your way, Azel. I'll head right out.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「If you intend to bow before God, I have no reason to stop you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Life here demands much fortitude, yet the silence of the church is agreeable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, sure, nobody talks during worship, but......」

name: Azel
message: 「But what?」

name: Misa
message: 「My voice is warmed up and ready! Come on, let's get started.」

name: Shio
message: 「Practicing on your own initiative--truly worthy of you, Sister. I shall strive to follow your admirable example.」

name: Azel
message: 「What are those?」
Looking at Misa and Shio-chan coming over from the entrance, Azel asks with overt weariness.

name: Synn
message: 「That's Misa and Shio-chan.」

name: Azel
message: 「I know.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, maybe they're going to practice hymns?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Those things are going to sing?」

name: Shio
message: 「'Th-Those things,' you say?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me! Please don't refer to people with demonstrative pronouns!」

name: Synn
message: 「Believe it or not, Misa is the captain of the choir, you know, Azel?」

name: Misa
message: 「'Believe it or not'? And what exactly is that supposed to mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then, let me hear it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh? W-Well, sure, I don't mind? That is the kind of song it is, after all.」
True to the choir's reputation, Misa sings a hymn out loud and clear, with Shio-chan harmonizing alongside her.
Azel is listening intently, looking completely at ease. That just goes to show how wonderful Misa's singing is.

name: Misa
message: 「How was that, Azel-san? Oh, and Sakura-kun too, I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「That was delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd rather you not describe it the exact same way you talk about food!」

name: Shio
message: 「However, she truly is quite skilled, is she not?」

name: Synn
message: 「You bet! You felt that way too, right, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I wouldn't know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Faith is something to be buried deep within one's heart. Therefore, um...」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Elder Sister worked twice as hard as anyone else to earn her position as captain.」

name: Shio
message: 「And so, she sings of a faith forged through endurance, with poignant and exquisite beauty.」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh, honestly, Shio.」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Something like that is...」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing more than a frivolous song!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ggaaaahhhhhhhhh!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Sister!? Please, stay with me.」

name: Azel
message: 「Move!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, wait!」
Chasing after Azel, who has run off, I dash out of the church.

name: Azel
message: 「Stay back!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go apologize together.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It wasn't bad. Tell that captain I said so.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's something you have to tell them yourself, Azel!」
Azel didn't answer and walked inside the school building.
I do a 180 and head back toward the church. The sooner I explain the situation, the better.
I'm only covering for you this once, Azel!!
